verdict.rationale: Heap lists "Account analytics" as a named feature on a paid plan tier. It also documents an add-account-properties endpoint for sending account-level attributes (payment tier, account owner, account name) "for analysis," which is first-party support for company-level rather than per-user analysis. missing for 10: documentation of how accounts are modeled and grouped, evidence of account-level funnels/retention reports, independent or hands-on corroboration, and availability beyond a higher pricing tier.
